svg.text: Pool controller perfboard (7 x 9 cm, component side)
ESPHome pins: radar on GPIO16/17, valve on GPIO23. Bare buses run on the underside; coloured wires are insulated, on top.
ESP32 RX2 / GPIO16 (E8) → J1 TX (radar TX)
ESP32 TX2 / GPIO17 (E9) → J1 RX (radar RX)
J1 GND, J2 GND, J3 GND → GND bus
• Solder the headers with the ESP32 plugged into them, so the spacing always matches your board.
If your ESP32 is the narrow type, its right row lands on column N instead of O. Wire it the same way.
• Crossing lines with no dot are NOT connected (wire passes over the bare bus).
• Radar: TX/RX are as labelled on the radar. If it reads nothing, swap the two wires at J1.
• All grounds meet on the GND bus. The 12V never touches this board.
